name: ConnectLA: Nextlink activates the first BEAD-funded tower
known_limitations: The state release establishes one live tower and service availability for 104 BEAD locations. It does not disclose a location list, subscriber count, test sample, latency, uptime, adoption, affordability, or closeout result.
